title: WasmRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Runs a core Wasm unit through the Harness JSON ABI behind the runtime contract.

inputs.name: WasmRuntimeAdapter.constructor.file
inputs.description: A filesystem path passed to readFile to obtain the WebAssembly module bytes when the runtime first loads the module. If reading fails, the loader rejects with the error returned by wasmUnavailable.

inputs.name: WasmRuntimeAdapter.constructor.options
inputs.description: Runtime options forwarded to the superclass adapter. timeoutMs sets the runtime deadline; omitted or nullish values use defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs.

errors.name: wasmUnavailable
errors.description: On a file read failure, the deferred loader throws the error returned by wasmUnavailable with the message Wasm module ${file} cannot be read. That error is named RuntimeUnavailable; during invocation, the superclass turns load failures into a runtime-unavailable response.
